We're offering the Global Excellence Scholarship to high-achieving international students from across the globe who choose to study with us.

If you’re looking to start studying in 2027, you could receive up to 20%* off your tuition fees for the entire duration of your eligible undergraduate or postgraduate course. So you can stay focussed on achieving excellence in your studies and making an impact in our world.

The Global Excellence Scholarship is an annual tuition fee discount for the normal full-time duration of the awardee’s course as specified in their letter of offer. The value of the scholarship is determined by the applicant’s equivalent Australian Tertiary Admission Rank (ATAR) or UWA weighted average mark (WAM).
Students from all countries are eligible.
You will need to have received an offer for an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate course for 2027 at The University of Western Australia

To be eligible to be considered for the scholarship, a candidate must be applying for an eligible undergraduate course, combined bachelor’s degree, combined bachelor’s and master’s degree, or Assured Pathway course. The following exclusions apply:
You will need to have also achieved an equivalent* of the following:
minimum ATAR* 85.00 for 10% off your tuition fees
minimum ATAR* 90.00 for 20% off your tuition fees
*International and overseas qualifications achieved at a certain level make you eligible for this scholarship. Other programs or qualifications will be considered on an individual basis.
To be eligible to be considered for the scholarship, a candidate must be applying for an eligible postgraduate course. The following exclusions apply:
You will need to have also achieved the following:
minimum WAM 65.00 for 10% off your tuition fees
minimum WAM 75.00 for 20% off your tuition fees
Combined bachelor’s and combined bachelors and master’s (CBM) eligibility
All combined bachelor’s and combined bachelor’s and master’s degrees are considered eligible.
The scholarship is automatically awarded to those who are eligible based on ATAR/WAM requirements.

How do I find out if my current qualifications satisfy the requirements for this scholarship?

The Global Excellence Scholarship will be assessed by UWA Admissions upon submission of your final academic transcript. The value of the Scholarship is determined by your equivalent Australian Tertiary Admission Rank (ATAR) or UWA weighted average mark (WAM). To determine your eligibility, please submit your application to your chosen UWA course, including your final academic transcripts.
What is the next step if I've been successful in obtaining this scholarship?

You'll find out in your offer letter whether you've been awarded a scholarship. Once you accept your offer, tuition fees are payable each semester (twice annually). Before your payment is due, our Fees team will calculate your tuition fees and automatically apply your scholarship.

I have not received my final transcripts yet – am I still eligible to be considered for the Global Excellence Scholarship?

Upon receiving your application to study at UWA, our Admissions team assesses your eligibility for your chosen degree – this can be based on your predicted/incomplete results. However, eligibility for the Global Excellence Scholarship can only be assessed once we receive your final transcripts. If we have not received your final transcripts, Admissions may issue a conditional offer letter without a Scholarship attached.
After you submit your final transcripts, Admissions will take one of the following actions:
If you have not accepted your conditional offer and your final transcripts meet the Scholarship criteria, Admissions will send you a new offer that includes the Scholarship.

If you have accepted your conditional offer (and made the initial payment) and your final transcripts meet the Scholarship criteria, Admissions will provide you with a Scholarship contract to sign. The Scholarship amount for that semester will then be credited to your student account.
Am I eligible for the Global Excellence Scholarship if I’m successful for another UWA funded scholarship?
The Global Excellence Scholarship may not be held concurrently with any other UWA issued tuition fee reduction, academic scholarship or award.

I have received the Global Excellence Scholarship for 2027. If I defer my offer to commence for 2028 intake, will I still receive the scholarship?

The Global Excellence Scholarship is in place for 2027 - 2029 intakes, so you can defer your commencement to 2028 with confidence that your scholarship and place at UWA is there for when you are ready to join us.
